audit_law.scoring_rule: Recompute each task using the same frozen direct requirements, task routes, and pre-existing repaired architecture; predictable grammatical morphology must be applied before declaring a lexical component unavailable.
audit_law.morphology_rule: A predictable grammatical form created from an admitted word does not consume another vocabulary slot.
audit_law.comparison_rule: Record every historical→corrected score change and every case where a historically credited A/B would become C under the corrected scorer.

stop_conditions: Stop if historical result blob differs.
Stop if corrected scoring requires a new lexical concept or productive rule.
